mixedPolicies: Only older opted-in overlapping operations superseded; FIFO protected
multiRegion: Whole old request superseded on any intersection; no early reservation release
inFlight: Invalidate entering activation; keep all ownership until callback drains; exit callbacks always drained
alreadyShownLimitation: Show-before-To preserved; cannot retroactively suppress display or undo side effects
uncooperativeLimitation: Can block indefinitely; guarded publication denied but callback never detached
validity: Capture NavigationActivation before await; TryPublish synchronous on owning Unity thread
cleanup: Once per activation/ownership registration; notification completes before resource/token disposal; all cleanup attempts made
exceptions: Callback or aggregate cleanup faults remain observable; queued supersession is OperationCanceledException
sameId: Valid active lifetime reused; no forced Away/To re-entry
sharedVm: One logical activation cohort; any exit ends it; no mutation of unowned Region; concurrent callbacks across operations rejected
reentrancy: Scoped Navigation required; validation before supersession; root raw service external-only
customServices: Explicit Fifo forwards; Latest unsupported throws, no silent fallback
finalDispose: Unchanged; Clear/quiesce before provider final Dispose; no new cache/root disposal API
